items.exampleEn: These old coins are no longer in circulation.
items.exampleZh: 這些舊硬幣已經不再流通了。

items.exampleEn: Discard the outer leaves of the cabbage before you cook it.
items.exampleZh: 煮高麗菜之前，先把外層的葉子丟掉。

items.exampleEn: Rumors about the new boss circulated quickly around the office.
items.exampleZh: 關於新老闆的傳言很快就在辦公室傳開了。

items.exampleEn: Fresh flowers can elevate a simple family dinner.
items.exampleZh: 新鮮的花可以讓簡單的家常晚餐更有格調。

items.exampleEn: The heavy snow obliged us to cancel our trip.
items.exampleZh: 大雪迫使我們取消了旅行。

items.exampleEn: The hotel misplaced our booking, so we had to wait an hour.
items.exampleZh: 飯店把我們的訂房資料弄丟了，所以我們得等一個小時。

items.exampleEn: A clear form can expedite the whole process.
items.exampleZh: 一份清楚的表格可以加快整個流程。

items.exampleEn: The cleaner accidentally unplugged the fridge during the night.
items.exampleZh: 清潔人員半夜不小心拔掉了冰箱的插頭。

items.sentenceEn: Please unplug the heater before you leave the office.
items.sentenceZh: 離開辦公室前，請拔掉暖氣機的插頭。

items.audioEn: I have misplaced my reading glasses again. Have you seen them anywhere?
items.audioZh: 我又把老花眼鏡放到不知道哪裡去了。你有在哪裡看到嗎？

items.sentenceEn: Open the windows to let the air circulate.
items.sentenceZh: 把窗戶打開，讓空氣流通。

items.sentenceEn: The new stage elevates the speaker so that everyone can see her.
items.sentenceZh: 新的舞台把講者架高，讓每個人都看得到她。

items.stemEn: We paid an extra fee to ____ the delivery of our new sofa.
items.stemZh: 我們多付了一筆費用，讓新沙發能加快送達。

items.stemEn: The rules ____ all visitors to wear a helmet on the building site.
items.stemZh: 規定要求所有訪客在工地都必須戴安全帽。

items.passageEn: Before our office moved to a new building, the manager circulated a short list of instructions. Everyone had to discard any papers they no longer needed and unplug their computers on Friday afternoon. The moving company promised to expedite the work so that we could start again on Monday. Still, a few things went wrong. Some boxes were misplaced, and one colleague spent a whole morning looking for her files. The new office, however, is much better. The windows are larger, the circulation of fresh air is good, and the meeting room is on the top floor, elevated above the noise of the street.
items.passageZh: 我們辦公室搬到新大樓之前，經理傳閱了一份簡短的指示清單。每個人都得丟掉不再需要的文件，並在星期五下午拔掉電腦插頭。搬家公司答應加快作業，讓我們星期一就能重新開工。不過，還是出了一些差錯。有些箱子放錯了地方，一位同事花了一整個早上找她的檔案。話雖如此，新辦公室好多了。窗戶比較大，新鮮空氣流通良好，會議室在頂樓，位置高出街面，遠離街上的噪音。

questions.questionZh: 星期五下午，大家要對電腦做什麼？
新辦公室比舊的好在哪裡？

items.promptZh: 我一時找不到我的手機，結果發現它在車上。
referenceEn: I misplaced my phone, but then I found it in the car.
I had misplaced my phone, and later I found it in my car.
rubricZh: misplace 表示「放錯地方、一時找不到」（例如 misplaced my phone 等）
「結果發現」可寫，例如 but then I found it、later I found it 等
時態配合內容（例如 misplaced、had misplaced 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 be obliged to 或 feel obliged to 造一個句子，說說你在工作或生活中不得不做的事。
referenceEn: I am obliged to wear a uniform at work.
I felt obliged to help my neighbor move to a new apartment.
rubricZh: be obliged to、feel obliged to 後接原形動詞，表示「（因規定或情理）不得不」（例如 am obliged to wear 等）
時態配合內容（例如 am、felt 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：elevated above the noise of the street 譯「遠離街上的噪音」漏掉「位置架高、高於」之意；且前後兩句都以「不過，」開頭，重複。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 補譯 elevated：「會議室在頂樓，位置高出街面，遠離街上的噪音」；第二個「不過」改「話雖如此」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：q14 干擾項 circulation 跨課重複
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: circulation 換成本課動詞 discard

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（App 單字卡只顯示釋義第一義）：circulate 釋義第一義「傳閱」不是例句示範的詞義
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 釋義改為「流通、傳開；傳閱」，雙義配對的干擾項同步對調

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（App 單字卡只顯示釋義第一義）：misplace 釋義第一義「放錯地方」不是例句示範的詞義
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 釋義改為「一時找不到；放錯地方」，雙義配對的干擾項同步對調

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：misplace 表示「放錯地方、一時找不到」（例如 misplaced my phone 等）／「結果發現」可寫，例如 but then I found it、later I found it 等／時態配合內容（例如 misplaced、had misplaced 等）
